verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt is served (HTTP 200) at developer.mastercard.com, and the Open Finance docs are published as agent-readable Markdown (index.md) pages. Mastercard's Agent Toolkit also explicitly targets AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf), giving agents contextual answers pulled from the docs. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt specifically indexes the Open Finance (Finicity) docs rather than only the general Mastercard Developers platform, and independent corroboration of how well agents use these docs.
